messages:
Maya R (Finance): @here FY25 year-end procurement note: we're rolling out an updated vendor approval threshold and PO cutoff. Please read and action if you own vendor spend.

Ethan (FP&A): TL;DR?

Maya R (Finance): Effective immediately, any vendor spend >= $10,000 requires Procurement + FP&A pre-approval and a PO issued before invoice/payment. This helps us manage Q4 commitments and forecasts.

Sasha (Procurement): New request flow is live on the portal: create Request -> attach SOW/quote -> choose 'Vendor Onboard' -> assign approver. Link: https://internal.redwood/procurement/new-request :point_right:

ben (eng): What about existing renewals that auto-bill next month?

Maya R (Finance): If a renewal >= $10k is set to auto-renew, please pause auto-renewals (vendor or card) and submit a vendor request by EOD Friday 2025-11-28. We'll fast-track approvals for renewals.

ben (eng): Got it. Who should I cc on the request for exceptions?

Sasha (Procurement): CC procurement@redwood.com and your FP&A owner. For urgent items, tag #procurement-urgent in the request so we can triage.

ProcurementBot: PO 12459 created for 'ACME Vector' (requested by ben). Status: pending-approval.

Ethan (FP&A): Reminder: corporate cards may not be used to bypass the PO requirement for >= $10k. Card charges >= $2k still need pre-approval and Concur coding.

Maya R (Finance): Exceptions: legal retainers and emergency cloud spend — flag as 'emergency' and route to the Finance Director for same-day decisions.

sara (ops): Quick question — does this change affect existing dedicated infra reserved capacity contracts?

Maya R (Finance): No change for active SOWs or existing committed-capacity contracts. New commitments follow the new approval path.

ben (eng): Thanks. I'll pause the renewal and submit the request now.

Sasha (Procurement): Thanks all. We'll host a 20-min drop-in tomorrow 11:00 PST to walk through the portal and checklist. Invite: https://calendly.link/procurement-dropin

Ethan (FP&A): +1 — I'll post a quick checklist in #finance later today with templates and approver matrix.

ProcurementBot: Reminder scheduled: submit vendor requests before 2025-11-28 23:59 PST to avoid delays.

Maya R (Finance): Appreciate quick action. Ping me or @Sasha for any blockers. :pray:
